content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":197,"severity":"minor","message":"Inconsistent regex quantifier for duplicate slash removal: intermediate parts use `/{1,}/g` (match 1+ slashes) while remnant uses `/{2,}/g` (match 2+ slashes).
